title: Containment of NP in polynomial space
statement: Every language in $\mathrm{NP}$ belongs to $\mathrm{PSPACE}$, the class of languages decidable using polynomial space; that is, $\mathrm{NP}\subseteq\mathrm{PSPACE}$.
